connector.name: Colab Drive MCP
connector.registryDescription: Synchronize Colab notebook files through Google Drive without executing notebook code.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package colab-drive-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yummytastycode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: COLAB_MCP_ROOT
env.description: Absolute local directory that bounds notebook file access.

env.name: COLAB_MCP_DRIVE_ACCESS
env.description: Google Drive access mode: file for minimal access or full for discovering existing notebooks.

env.name: COLAB_MCP_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Optional path to the local Google OAuth Desktop client JSON.

env.name: COLAB_MCP_GOOGLE_TOKEN
env.description: Optional path to the local Google OAuth token JSON.
